initial_control: Exact C143 final step12; never updated in place.
direction_rules: Negative aggregate gradient of the original C143 training objective over all84 at C143 final a.
Negative softmax32-weighted gradient of q_i=max(abs(response_i))/.002 over all84 at the same frozen a.
direction_normalization: Negative gradient divided by its Linf norm; norm<=1e-14 gives an explicit zero direction, never an arbitrary fallback.
functional_parity: All84 native/function comparisons before any backward; point/observations2e-6 and KL2e-7. Gradient-forward observations must agree with the fixed functional baseline.
preflight: All84 prepared/raw/C140/C143 native points; original point/gate identity and observations2e-4, KL5e-6; drift blocks before any backward.
probe_control_rule: a_probe=clip(a_C143+sign*h*direction,-.125,.125); every clipping event and actual coefficient displacement recorded. All8 vectors and all756 points sealed before probe measurements.
diagnostic_only: All eight signed fixed probes evaluated on every84 state twice. No adaptive step, line search, optimizer, iterative fit, best point/radius/direction selection or deployment. Both signs and both steps retained, even if a direction is zero or proposals coincide.
linear_prediction: q_i(a_probe) approximately q_i(a0)+archived-at-runtime grad(q_i) dot actual coefficient displacement; reported only as a local AD linearization diagnostic. Max/tie changes, clipping, float32 steps and nonlinear effects are retained; discrepancies do not prove AD error.
scope: Exposed training-domain finite directional probes only. No independent derivative accuracy, feasibility/infeasibility, convergence, fresh local confirmation or excluded-input generalisation claim. All84 pass at a probe is descriptive and does not select a writer or close LC2.
